primary.title: Pulse of the Street: Sensex, Nifty rally on TCS earnings after midweek rout
primary.summary: On Friday, the BSE Sensex jumped 1.08% to close at 77,569.39, while the Nifty 50 gained 1.02% to settle at 24,206.90. The gains built on Thursday’s modest recovery of 0.31% and 0.34%, respectively, after Wednesday’s sharp sell-off.
